steps.title: Агрегаты и FILTER
steps.content:
## Агрегаты

`COUNT`, `SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN`, `MAX`. `COUNT(DISTINCT x)`. Условная агрегация: `SUM(CASE WHEN …)` или `COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …)` (SQLite 3.30+).

content.caption: GROUP BY сворачивает строки
content.description: Без GROUP BY агрегат по всей таблице.

content.setup: CREATE TABLE Cinema(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, movie TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, rating REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT * FROM Cinema ORDER BY rating DESC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT * FROM Cinema WHERE id % 2 = 1 AND description != 'boring' ORDER BY rating DESC;

content.description:
Средняя цена продажи каждого `product_id` за период (Units с `purchase_date` между «2019-01-01» и «2019-06-30»). Колонка `average_price`, округление 2 знака; нет продаж → NULL.

[LeetCode 1251](https://leetcode.com/problems/average-selling-price/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Products(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL, price INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Units(product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, purchase_date TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, AVG(price) AS average_price FROM Products GROUP BY product_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT p.product_id, ROUND(AVG(u.amount * p.price * 1.0) / NULLIF(SUM(u.amount), 0), 2) AS average_price FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Units u ON p.product_id = u.product_id AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN "2019-01-01" AND "2019-06-30" GROUP BY p.product_id;

steps.title: 1661. Average Time of Process per Machine

content.description:
Среднее время обработки (`processing_time`, округление **3** знака) для каждой `machine_id`: по каждой паре `(machine_id, process_id)` время = `end` − `start`, затем среднее по машине.

[LeetCode 1661](https://leetcode.com/problems/average-time-of-process-per-machine/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activity(machine_id INTEGER NOT NULL, process_id INTEGER NOT NULL, activity_type TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT machine_id, AVG(timestamp) AS processing_time FROM Activity GROUP BY machine_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT machine_id, ROUND(AVG(end_time - start_time), 3) AS processing_time FROM (SELECT machine_id, process_id, MAX(CASE WHEN activity_type = "start" THEN timestamp END) AS start_time, MAX(CASE WHEN activity_type = "end" THEN timestamp END) AS end_time FROM Activity GROUP BY machine_id, process_id) t GROUP BY machine_id;

steps.title: 1633. Percentage of Users Attended a Contest

content.description:
Доля пользователей, участвовавших в **хотя бы одном** контесте (`registered_in_contest`), округлить до 2 знаков — `percentage`.

[LeetCode 1633](https://leetcode.com/problems/percentage-of-users-attended-a-contest/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Register(contest_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(contest_id, user_id));
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Users), 2) AS percentage FROM Register r;

INSERT INTO Register VALUES (215,6),(209,2),(208,2);

content.description:
По `(month, country)`: `approved_count`, `approved_amount` (только state approved), `chargeback_count`, `chargeback_amount` (только chargeback). Месяц — `YYYY-MM` из `trans_date`.

[LeetCode 1193](https://leetcode.com/problems/monthly-transactions-i/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Transactions(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, country TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, trans_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT strftime("%Y-%m", trans_date) AS month, country,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN state = "approved" THEN 1 END) AS approved_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN state = "approved" THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_amount,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN state = "chargeback" THEN 1 END) AS chargeback_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN state = "chargeback" THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS chargeback_amount
FROM Transactions GROUP BY month, country ORDER BY month, country;

content.description:
Доля заказов первого заказа клиента (`order_number=1`), доставленных в **первый** день (`order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date`), в процентах `immediate_percentage` (2 знака).

[LeetCode 1174](https://leetcode.com/problems/immediate-food-delivery-ii/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Delivery(delivery_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, order_date TEXT NOT NULL, customer_pref_delivery_date TEXT NOT NULL, delivery_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(SUM(order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS immediate_percentage FROM Delivery WHERE (customer_id, order_date) IN (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) FROM Delivery GROUP BY customer_id);

content.description:
Доля игроков, которые заходили **на следующий календарный день** после дня первого входа. Одна строка: `fraction` (округлить 2 знака).

[LeetCode 550](https://leetcode.com/problems/game-play-analysis-iv/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activity(player_id INTEGER NOT NULL, device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event_date TEXT NOT NULL, games_played INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution:
WITH first_login AS (SELECT player_id, MIN(event_date) AS fd FROM Activity GROUP BY player_id)
SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) FROM Activity a JOIN first_login f ON a.player_id = f.player_id WHERE a.event_date = DATE(f.fd, "+1 day")) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT player_id), 2) AS fraction FROM Activity;

content.description:
По каждому `query_name`: `quality` = avg(rating/position), `poor_query_percentage` = % rating < 3 (оба округлить 2 знака).

[LeetCode 1211](https://leetcode.com/problems/queries-quality-and-percentage/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Queries(query_name TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT query_name FROM Queries GROUP BY query_name;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT query_name,
  ROUND(AVG(rating * 1.0 / position), 2) AS quality,
  ROUND(SUM(rating < 3) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS poor_query_percentage
FROM Queries GROUP BY query_name;
